title: WinStar Cruises
specs: Double-decker cruiser with open-air and enclosed decks
Views of Bell Estate, bird sanctuaries, lighthouses, and local landmarks
Private bookings available for events from June 1 to October 17, 2026
includes: Guided narration with microphone and sound system
Licensed bar aboard with local craft beer, wine, spirits, and non-alcoholic drinks
blurb: Guests join a 90-minute scenic boat tour on the Bras d'Or Lakes from Baddeck, Nova Scotia. The tour includes educational and entertaining narration with views of local landmarks, wildlife, and historical sites. The vessel offers enclosed and open-air seating, a licensed bar, and is pet-friendly.
extraNote: No advance deposits required for individuals or small groups · Tours operate rain or shine · Baddeck Wharf, at the end of the wharf · June 1 through October 17, 2026
